ui_badge_plus.notes: Cream circle with green plus, matching the approved mock; no stock numeral.

ui_rope_short.source: V5 rope_segment.png, resized with symmetric three-row seam blend
ui_rope_short.notes: Vertical repeat; first and last RGBA rows are byte-identical. Do not stretch in width.

ui_close_x.notes: Complete close button including its X; do not place another square behind it.

ico_coin.notes: ico_coin is an additional source-only companion needed by the asset-only K3 composite.

goal_house_roof.source: art/v6/derived/house_sunny.png, golden fill mask and neutral maximum-channel tint base
goal_house_roof.notes: Aligned 88x90 canvas. Unity multiply-tint this sprite. The brown roof contour stays in goal_house_body so it retains its original color. Render roof then body.

goal_house_body.source: art/v6/derived/house_sunny.png, roof fill removed and connected dark doorway cut out
goal_house_body.notes: Aligned 88x90 canvas, including the original brown roof outline. Clear door opening bounds top-left: (23,43)-(65,82), center (44,62.5). Put the species portrait behind the body, above the tray; use an arch portrait mask to prevent leaks.

gift_encore.source: T40 no_count.png with +1 masked; surface_badge.png and close.png counter composite
gift_encore.notes: Footprint + feather + crossed empty counter. No +1, letters or numerals; the tiny crossed counter is secondary detail at 44 px.

node_cleared.notes: Node base only. Code composes stars, bird, lock and number separately. Current and open bases are intentionally identical, as in T40.

node_current.notes: Node base only. Code composes stars, bird, lock and number separately. Current and open bases are intentionally identical, as in T40.

node_open.notes: Node base only. Code composes stars, bird, lock and number separately. Current and open bases are intentionally identical, as in T40.

node_locked.notes: Node base only. Code composes stars, bird, lock and number separately. Current and open bases are intentionally identical, as in T40.

node_bounce_shadow.notes: Static shadow sprite only; no animation claim.

gate_locked.notes: Aspect-fit gate, preserving T40 proportions; 720x300 canvas has transparent side margins. Actual art bounds are in this manifest; do not stretch horizontally.

gate_open.notes: Aspect-fit gate, preserving T40 proportions; 720x300 canvas has transparent side margins. Actual art bounds are in this manifest; do not stretch horizontally.

map_path_segment.source: art/v6/raw/map_background.png, clean sand crop (520,1510,610,1600), resize, 32-row seam blend, side alpha mask
map_path_segment.notes: 360x360 vertical repeating sand strip, first/last rows identical. This is a straight texture segment; the scrolling map must position/curve the path. No baked trees, nodes, labels or background.
